b1.watch_honors_klbkch.news: The Watch gave Senior Guardsman Klbkch a new badge for ten years in Liscor, and booked Wishdrinks for his party at the end of the week.

canon_ref.note: Evening. In 1.30 Relc says the badge was two days before Klbkch died, so day 19. Deltas are design values.

b1.watch_honors_klbkch.summary: Weary and near despair after ten silent years, Klbkch gives Zevara his week's report; she shrugs off his punch at Relc. Downstairs he nearly draws on a surprise party. The Watch gives him a silver-and-blue badge. In the Hive he screams at the mindless Workers.
